### B-001: Helm ClusterRole missing autoscaling RBAC rule
**File**: `operators/keystone/helm/keystone-operator/templates/clusterrole.yaml:142` — **Fix**: AUTO-FIX — **Confidence**: verified — **Pattern**: Sync RBAC markers with Helm ClusterRole templates

**Problem**: The controller declares kubebuilder RBAC markers for autoscaling resources and SetupWithManager owns HorizontalPodAutoscaler, but the Helm ClusterRole template has no autoscaling apiGroup entry. When deployed via Helm, the operator will receive 403 Forbidden on every HPA create/get/update/delete call, silently breaking reconciliation for any Keystone CR with spec.autoscaling set.

**Code**:
```
# clusterrole.yaml ends at line 156 with coordination.k8s.io — no autoscaling rule
```

**Action Required**: Add an autoscaling RBAC rule to the Helm ClusterRole template after the policy rule.

**Suggested Fix**:
```
  # autoscaling - horizontalpodautoscalers (CC-0038)
  - apiGroups:
      - autoscaling
    resources:
      - horizontalpodautoscalers
    verbs:
      - get
      - list
      - watch
      - create
      - update
      - patch
      - delete
```

**Related**: B-002

## Resolution Summary
All three actionable review findings (B-001, B-002, W-001) were addressed. The autoscaling RBAC rule was added to the Helm ClusterRole template, CRD YAMLs were regenerated to include the spec.autoscaling schema with CEL validation, and the duplicated normalizeMap closure was extracted to a package-level function. The CRD regeneration was applied to both operators/keystone/helm/keystone-operator/crds/ and operators/keystone/config/crd/bases/ (B-002 only mentioned the Helm CRD, but the config/crd/bases copy also needed updating to stay in sync). The normalizeMap extraction in internal/common/deployment/deployment.go removed the inline closure from both EnsurePDB and EnsureHPA, replacing both call sites with the shared helper. INFO items (I-001, I-002, I-003) required no immediate action and were not addressed in this changeset.
